data.display_address: The Stella Residences, Al Furjan, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover spacious and comfortable living at The Stella Residences with this well-appointed 2-bedroom apartment plus maid’s room, offering a total area of 1,584.01 sq. ft. Thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles, this home provides the perfect balance of space, functionality, and comfort within a well-maintained residential community.

The unit features a bright and airy open-plan living and dining area, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. Both bedrooms are generously sized and fitted with built-in wardrobes, ensuring ample storage and everyday convenience. With three modern bathrooms finished with quality fittings, the apartment offers comfort and practicality for all residents. The additional maid’s room adds extra flexibility, suitable for household assistance, storage, or utility use.

Large windows throughout the apartment allow natural light to flow in, enhancing the sense of space and creating a pleasant living environment. The layout is efficiently planned to maximize usability while maintaining privacy between living and private areas.

Residents enjoy access to a selection of premium amenities including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, covered parking, and 24/7 security, ensuring a safe and convenient lifestyle. The community is strategically located with easy access to major highways, retail destinations, dining options, and essential services.

Features & Amenities:

 • 2 Bedroom + Maid’s Room
 • 3 Bathrooms
 • Built-in wardrobes
 • Spacious open-plan living & dining
 • Modern bathrooms with quality finishes
 • Swimming pool
 • Fully equipped gym
 • Covered parking
 • 24/7 security

A perfect choice for those seeking space, comfort, and a well-connected lifestyle.
